methodology: Exact single-roll probabilities; real multiplayer engine and draft, fixed seeds; three heuristic controllers, not optimal or human players. All variants use the current rules, including skaters, owner-color wild stars, paired drafts, three-trick sequence points and persistent freeze. Historical report files describe older rules. Catalog variants exist in memory only. Draft point caps remain those of the current game and can change offers. Freeze preserves a face only when it improves the next chosen trick. Adjust planner includes choices in its cache key.
